ratings_why.fun: Over a 7 because seating and shop order are real choices every turn: who sits left of Coronella, who sits beside Anguis, which scene Eft rehearses, and lending Play Dead to an Ooze to open its Belly early.
ratings_why.distinct: Deathrattle-plus-Reborn roots, but going limp in the slot, the Curtain Call reveal and a bluff that fools the enemy too play unlike today's tribes.

verdict_why: Hesketh and Anguis make an endless loop, and the Curtain Call text contradicts the extra lives; both need a real fix.

points.text: Little Anguis (or his Tail) can copy Sir Hesketh's Death Scene; that copy triggers Hesketh's scene, which triggers Anguis's copy again, forever. Say scenes Hesketh triggers can't trigger Hesketh's scene, or copies of it.
Curtain Call says Play Dead is used up, but Dame Natrix plays dead twice and Žilvinas adds lives. Say whether units keep their remaining lives after getting up.
Household Guardian only hands out gold or a life. Let a Saucer also be drunk to trigger one Death Scene, so it joins the rehearsal engine.
The Natterjack pays most for nearly losing. Paying per unit that went down (capped) would reward Coronella and Wardrobe setups instead of throwing fights.
Tails rehearsed in the shop clutter the board at 0 sell value. Let a new Tail merge into an existing one, adding its stats, to keep the slots for choices.

standouts.why: Coronella turns the left slot into a puzzle: Berus bites early, Hesketh plays the whole repertoire pre-fight, an Ooze opens its Belly.
Little Anguis copies whatever falls beside him, including other tribes' death effects, so seating decides what he becomes.
Prompt-Box Eft plays scenes in the shop, which with Old Crest and Hesketh gives a recruit-time engine with real targeting choices.

weakest.why: Household Guardian is a flat resource drip with no tie to seating or scenes.
Chorus Snake is plain Reborn on a body; fine as a seed but nothing to play around.
The Natterjack does one job, and it rewards near-losses more than clever setups.

flags.note: Endless loop with Little Anguis or his Tail copying Hesketh's Death Scene.
Old Crest with Hesketh and Eft multiplies scenes in the shop, about 4x and more with goldens.
2 gold per Curtain Call could make losing on purpose pay.
Two destroys a fight at Tier 5, three with Žilvinas, hard-counters big boards.
How Dame Natrix's second Play Dead interacts with Curtain Call using up Play Dead isn't stated.
